labels.status: HISTORICAL-DESCRIPTIVE (non-confirmatory); REG §2 not met; vintage-unpinned, non-evidential / BLOCKED-AS-EVIDENCE (M0 gap 1); identity = RETROSPECTIVE_JOIN (A07), identity_resolved_as_of = security_master ingested_at; conditional post-event co-movement description, not an attribution

classification_table.unclassified_rule: a category the table does not map is UNCLASSIFIED: listed, never counted

event_sources.selection:
rows whose exact '
'-split stock_code token equals a profile counter local_code (09988 alibaba hkd_9988; 00700 tencent hkd_0700)
every coverage cell listed with its state and disposition

clock_rules.s_c: first session on clock c whose REGULAR OPEN is strictly after t_avail (pre-open -> same day; in-session, HK midday break or after close -> next session; DISCLOSURE_DATE -> first session strictly after the date)
clock_rules.window: entry_anchor = calendar day before s_US; resolve_horizon_window(entry_anchor, h, HORIZON_UNIT_TRADING, MARKET_US); assert fill_date == s_US else ABSTAIN_FILL_MISMATCH; None -> ABSTAIN_RESOLVER_NONE
clock_rules.leg_return: close(coverage_date)/close(fill_date) - 1 on the adjusted total-return close; both endpoint bars present on exactly those sessions else ABSTAIN_MISSING_ENDPOINT
clock_rules.decision_time: D(s) = last NYSE session before s_US; every decision-time quantity uses bars <= D(s); the day-s move is excluded and disclosed
clock_rules.W_h: sessions s .. s+h inclusive (IL §1); the overlap window used by IL §3

collapse_rules.order: IL §3 steps 0..N run IN FULL before anything is counted (A22)
collapse_rules.duplicate_reports: repeated reports of one occurrence -> one event, earliest admissible t_avail
collapse_rules.programme: one programme -> one event; execution returns are evidence rows
collapse_rules.cross_counter: BABA and 9988 rows of one occurrence -> ONE alibaba episode; leg outcomes are columns of one episode, never extra N (IL §6)
collapse_rules.overlap: overlapping windows within an issuer group at the same h handled per IL §3 step 4 (absorb / confounded flags), never silently merged, never double-counted
collapse_rules.clusters: same-day shocks across issuer groups share a cluster key (trade date of s) and are counted in cluster-N, never merged into one episode (IL §8)
collapse_rules.exclusion_order: excluded-and-listed rows are removed before episode formation; the exclusion is listed with its ids
collapse_rules.programme_rule: among the selected rows of one issuer group, the capital_action rows whose category is general_mandate and whose title carries PLACING form ONE programme (proposal, pricing, completion = evidence rows); the frozen coverage exclusion then removes that programme for REG P05 with its ids listed (E0 gap 10: HK placement coverage misses general-mandate placings)

splits.TEST: prospective claims only; REG §2 registration gate not met, so S2 has no TEST
splits.purge: TRAIN episode with coverage_date >= 2024-01-01, or TUNE episode with coverage_date >= 2026-10-01 -> PURGED (counted visibly, never moved)
splits.manifest_rule: runs/s2_event_response/manifests/<Pxx>_h<h>.jsonl, sorted by (horizon, episode_key), canonical json lines; membership_sha256 per (protocol, h, split) = sha256 of that split's lines in order

baselines.ii: sign of the trailing-63-session excess at D(s): (BABA(D)/BABA(D63) - 1) - (SPY(D)/SPY(D63) - 1), exact bars on D and D63 for both legs, else direction 0
baselines.iii: direction of the all-events pooled prior = sign of the mean excess of all counted TRAIN episodes across the three families at that h (PRIMARY set), computed from TRAIN only; TRAIN cluster-N < 2 -> NOT ESTIMABLE (abstain, never 0.5, never +1 by default)
baselines.challenger: NOT ESTIMABLE (hierarchy legs above own-name unregistered; own-name honest-N printed beside)
baselines.pooling_weight: NOT ESTIMABLE whenever baseline (iii) is not estimable or own-name cluster-N < 2; the token is printed, never a number by default
baselines.proper_score: NOT SUPPORTED (REG P04: hit and excess are not a proper score)
baselines.hit_rule: hit = sign(excess) == direction; excess == 0 exactly -> non-hit, listed as a tie; direction 0 -> ABSTAIN

statistics.mean_excess_ci: mirror-trick block_bootstrap_ci: dates=concat(k,k), vals=concat(x,-x), mask=concat([True]*n,[False]*n), stat='mean', default draws/seed; block = one episode window W_h; cluster variable = cluster key (trade date of s)

minimum_evidence.derivation: one-sided alpha 0.05, power 0.80, hit rate 0.60 vs 0.50

abstention_ladder: ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT_CLUSTERS (cluster-N < 2: no test, no CI, per-episode rows printed descriptively)
first match wins; never a 0.5 fill (A25)
kill_hold_rule: Kill/continue per REG P01: a failed criterion prints KILL or HOLD-AS-RESEARCH and is never rescued by changing target, cohort or horizon after seeing results.

info_leak_predicate.series: q_t = close_t / close_price_t for BABA and SPY
info_leak_predicate.rule: any |q_t/q_{t-1} - 1| > 1e-6 on a date >= the earliest TUNE anchor and <= the last input bar
info_leak_predicate.effect: TUNE RETIRED for P04/P05/P06 (per family with a non-empty TUNE); TUNE still computed and printed, labelled NON-CONFIRMATORY — TUNE RETIRED (A23 INFO-LEAK)
info_leak_predicate.ledger_row: log_trial(config={event: holdout_retired, protocol_id, version, split: TUNE, membership_sha256, contamination_class, detected_at (BASE commit date, deterministic), evidence}, family=sni.s2_event_response.<Pxx>, source=sni_s0_holdout_retirement) inside the register_trials block after the budget row
info_leak_predicate.manifest_row: a retirement row in runs/s2_event_response/LANE_MANIFEST.json with successor '<Pxx> v2 — not drafted; owner = seat/S0'
info_leak_predicate.invariance_note: a window return is invariant to a multiplicative adjustment constant across the window; the leak is the vintage, not necessarily the value
info_leak_predicate.hk_series: VINTAGE_UNVERIFIABLE (disclosed; HK series carry no adjustment-factor pair; not retired)
info_leak_predicate.membership_sha256_construction: sha256 of '|'.join(per-(protocol,h,TUNE) membership_sha256 for h in (5,21,63))

trial_ledger.required_arg: --trial-ledger-path is REQUIRED with NO default; the runner refuses (exit 2) any path resolving inside <repo>/data/
trial_ledger.effective_n: TrialLedger.effective_n = max(base, declared, 1); printed, never hidden; labelled effective N (trials) — never a sample N (IL §1)

report_order: REG §5 order: (1) plain-word null; (2) analysis set; (3) honest-N; (4) cluster-N; (5) literal row count; (6) visible exclusions; (7) test; (8) CI; (9) trial count; (10) receipt — then the commission family row

determinism.check: --check reruns into a temp dir and byte-compares every output against runs/s2_event_response/ (ledger compared after dropping ts); exit 0 iff identical
determinism.seal_verification: the runner first recomputes every membership_sha256 and the prereg digest and exits non-zero on any mismatch with the seal

event_exclusions_frozen.reason: E0 gap 10: HK placement coverage misses general-mandate placings; the one programme (one event under REG P05) is excluded and listed, never silently dropped
